uncovered_waiver.reason: OMN-19832 hand-flips node_pr_lifecycle_fix_effect at its ADAPTER BOUNDARY: the contract-bound HandlerPrLifecycleFixRuntime stops subclassing HandlerPrLifecycleFix and inheriting handle() (invisible to the classifier's class-body scan, which is why the node was baselined 'empty') and instead wraps it and defines handle(command: ModelPrLifecycleFixCommand) -> ModelHandlerOutput, so the effect can publish two events. This is NOT a pure boundary move and is not claimed as one: the same change adds behaviour (the typed ModelPrLandingCompanionOutcome event with command_id, op passed to the autobind producer for regenerate, the head read once and shared with the check-run marker). What is preserved is re-derived from git by the hand-flip proof: the delegation route, the autobind outcome classifier, handle_sync, the handler identity properties, the no-op adapters, the two-strike store and the unverified-companion verifier are byte-identical base_ref<->HEAD. The changed parts (_route gains op=, handle is split into _run/_result, the reporter takes a pre-read head) are covered by the executed parity tests, which pin the terminal ModelPrLifecycleFixResult emitted by the runtime to what HandlerPrLifecycleFix.handle returns for the same command (non-companion and autobind), plus the new outcome event, and fail on their own assertion at base_ref. Coverage: the recorder measured 44.14% because it starts coverage after the handler modules are imported, so every module-level def/class line and the Protocol stubs count as uncovered; measured with the imports inside the window the same 10-input corpus reaches 82% over both handler files. The genuinely uncovered branches are HandlerPrLifecycleFix.handle (the merge-sweep caller's path, not the contract-bound one, unchanged in behaviour and covered by test_the_merge_sweep_path_is_unchanged), the head-read exception and no-head branches, the delegation-eligible dispatch and the trivial-infra fast path, all covered by the node's unit suites (test_companion_outcome_omn_19832.py, test_handler_delegation_routing.py, test_occ_evidence_stamp.py).
